move: wallet builds, balance counts, cards swipe off and tuck behind thrice
how: A portrait dark wallet UI: header drops in, balance lines stagger up and the total counts to $12,480.50 with expo.out over 1.6s, three stacked cards rise from y 300 with a reverse 0.1s stagger (power3.out), transactions slide in from x 40 and a tab bar rises. The stack shows the front card flat with the two behind lifted 34px each, scaled .94/.88 and dimmed. At 29%, 53% and 76% the front card flies left (x -700, rotate -8, power3.in), is sent to the back by zIndex and returns with power3.out while the other two restack with power3.inOut and the page dots switch; each swipe re-counts the balance to that card's value. From 91% everything leaves the way it came and the counter resets at the last frame.
adapt: Replace the three card names, numbers, gradients, the balances per card, the transactions and the user avatar; keep the 0.5s power3.in throw and the 0.6s restack.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the screen from shot.cards and shot.transactions; animate returns the timeline with the build in the first 0.2D, swipes at 0.29D, 0.53D, 0.76D and exit from 0.91D. The card x -700 assumes a 1080-wide stage, derive from el width; scope the balance querySelector to el.
caveats: from() tweens need immediateRender:false when composed
